source.title: Richard Jay S. Apagar wins Asian Championship 2012
source.content:
[Richard Jay S. Apagar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010APAG01) won the [Asian Championship 2012](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2012) with an average of 9.45 seconds. [Nipat Charoenpholphant (นิพัฒน์ เจริญพลพันธุ์)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009CHAR03) finished second (9.47) and [Weixing Zhang (张炜星)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZHAN53) finished third (10.21).  
 Asian records: Weixing Zhang (张炜星) 4x4 Cube 28.10 (single).

translation.title: Richard Jay S. Apagar 夺得 2012 年亚洲锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Richard Jay S. Apagar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010APAG01) 以 9.45 秒的平均成绩赢得[2012 年亚洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2012)冠军。[Nipat Charoenpholphant（นิพัฒน์ เจริญพลพันธุ์）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009CHAR03)以 9.47 秒获得亚军，[Weixing Zhang（张炜星）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZHAN53)以 10.21 秒获得季军。

亚洲纪录：Weixing Zhang（张炜星），四阶单次 28.10 秒。
